sentences.en: Helen Murray Free invented self-testing equipment that lets diabetics measure their own blood levels of glucose at home.

sentences.en: The testing results from the self-testing grid indicated that the synchronization accuracy of scanning motor and the imaging quality of laser typesetter was both improved.
